name: Guangdong Hongtu Technology (holdings) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Hongtu Technology (holdings) Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells precision aluminum alloy die castings and related accessories in China. It offers precision aluminum alloy die castings and related accessories used in automotive, communication, and electromechanical products. The company also provides automobile signboards, radiator grilles, air-conditioning outlets, and other internal and external accessories. In addition, it offers investment and support services for strategic development, industrial upgrading, and business-related diversification of listed companies, as well as fund management services.
